name: Performance review written ABOUT the person, leads with the negative, uses the B-word, psychoanalyzes, and closes on process
draft:
Annual review: Priya Natarajan

Priya's output this year was mixed. Her reports can be too long and boring, and she should strive to be more concise. We understand that her performance was affected by her move and the situation with her father, which is why several deadlines slipped in Q2.

Priya has been actively involved on the team that shipped the new onboarding flow. She is a solid contributor and continues to evolve in her own way so that the team stays productive and effective.

Going forward, Priya should leverage her strengths and take more ownership. She needs to speak up more in meetings and stop being so passive.

I look forward to next year's review.
